title: PMMC: Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation for Long-Term LVLM Agents
event_hint: PMMC前瞻式多模态记忆编译
problem: 长期LVLM Agent需要在跨会话多模态历史中绑定图像与文本、处理时间更新并回忆视觉细节；固定caption/RAG表示或把所有规划留到查询时，会造成重复推理、证据错配和较高token/延迟成本。
mechanism: PMMC把部分记忆访问规划从query time移到consolidation time：Questioner根据已积累交互预测未来问题，Planner将每个问题编译为带类型、模态和证据契约的memory program，Doubter执行验证证据路径并对失败进行有限次修订。Question Bank只保存通过检查的canonical question、路由元数据和程序；在线按查询匹配并重新执行程序取回当前可见的原始证据，路由失败或readiness不满足时回退Native Multimodal RAG，不在线调用Questioner/Planner/Doubter。

evidence.claim: 在MEMLENS和Mem-Gallery、四个回答backbone的八个benchmark设置中，PMMC六项排名第一；总体Harmonized Judge宏平均为49.9，高于最强Caption-Text RAG基线46.7。
evidence.value: overall HJ 49.9 vs 46.7; first in 6/8 settings
evidence.condition: GPT-5-mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-27B; MEMLENS/Mem-Gallery
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 4 and 6, Table 1 and Empirical Results

evidence.claim: 在Qwen3.5-9B消融中，最多两次Planner–Doubter refinement（部署设置r=2）把宏平均HJ从无修订54.0提升到57.0、program success从82.7%提升到92.1%、fallback从22.4%降到12.6%，query-time tokens从3.8K降到3.2K；write-time tokens从18.7K增至31.8K。
evidence.condition: Qwen3.5-9B, macro average over MEMLENS and Mem-Gallery; r=2 deployed
evidence.source_locator: PDF page 7, Table 3 and Effect of Self-Feedback Rounds

evidence.claim: Question Bank的宏平均source coverage@5为82.1%，semantic match@5为75.2%；在线fallback率为12.6%，说明多数查询直接命中编译程序但仍存在路由覆盖缺口。
evidence.condition: Qwen3.5-9B, MEMLENS and Mem-Gallery; deployed PMMC routing

evidence.claim: 去除Doubter后HJ在MEMLENS/Mem-Gallery分别下降2.8/3.2分、program success从92.1降至82.7；用固定检索计划替代问题条件Planner会使evidence recall下降8.3分、raw-image hit下降10.6分、program success下降15.2分。
evidence.value: HJ -2.8/-3.2; success 92.1% -> 82.7%; evidence recall -8.3 pp; raw-image hit -10.6 pp; program success -15.2 pp
evidence.baseline: full PMMC with Doubter and dynamic Planner
evidence.condition: Qwen3.5-9B ablation across both multimodal memory benchmarks
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 5–7, Table 2 and Ablation Study

evidence.claim: PMMC在线程序不保存预测答案或私有来源支持，而是保存如何访问记忆的验证策略；程序在当前可见memory上重新执行，因此新变得可见的记忆仍可被取回，不能满足readiness时回退Native Multimodal RAG。
evidence.baseline: cached answer or fixed evidence identifiers
evidence.condition: Question Bank canonical entries and gold-free runtime readiness check
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 3–5, Execution-Grounded Verification and Online Routing

evaluation_context: 实验使用MEMLENS（699个可回答查询）和Mem-Gallery（1,446个可回答查询），四个LVLM backbone；同条件下比较长上下文、Caption-Text/Contrastive/Native MM-RAG和M3-Agent/M2A。开放模型在NVIDIA H100 80GB/vLLM上运行，最终回答最多32,768上下文和1,024输出token；PMMC使用前瞻问题预算8、最多两次Planner–Doubter修订、最多8个程序operator。
limitations: Question Bank覆盖并不完整，查询路由仍是瓶颈；更高修订次数只带来边际质量提升却增加写入token。PMMC的优势在同一compiled memory state被反复访问时更明显，首次整合有额外成本；未提供WAN RTT、跨区域缓存一致性或毫秒级P95，token成本不能直接等价为网络收益。去除raw-image会降低视觉证据命中，纯caption/文本索引无法替代原始图像。
project_relevance: （项目推断）可把Agent工具结果/图文记忆在 consolidation 阶段编译成经过执行验证的访问程序，再在跨域查询时只路由并回取必要证据；需按访问频率摊销写入成本，并以覆盖率、fallback、跨域读延迟和一致性验证是否值得保留。
source_notes: Primary arXiv PDF fetched; evidence retains benchmark, backbone, token-cost and fallback conditions.
No millisecond latency or WAN benefit inferred from token metrics.
